## Speed
How fast each measured model runs, against the previous release, is in the table on the [release page](https://github.com/aosama/astronomical/releases/tag/v0.2.137).
## Fixes
- **Ternary Bonsai 2.5 answers long prompts again.** In 0.2.136, a prompt long enough to be saved for reuse stopped with "astro SSD prompt cache failed during required persistent prompt-state capture". The saved state is now kept in the precision the model really uses (#2693). - **A prompt that cannot be saved for reuse no longer stops the reply.** Saving stops for that request and the reply goes on. Whatever was already saved still makes later requests faster.
## Compatibility
Your settings, models and conversations carry over unchanged. Astronomical needs macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon.
The app is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through a signed Sparkle update.
